motion_rule: the tray slides her down the aisle every second and she is never taken off it; counters, crates and ice sweep across the lens each beat; the camera tracks at her level; new shot size each beat, never wider than her head filling a third of frame, one action per beat
character: a plump mackerel with a mirror-striped flank, upright on her tail, jaw working, eye always clear
second_characters: ONE heavy seller in a white cap and stained apron, gold teeth, running alongside the tray from 6.45; ONE buyer, arms only, at 8.40
props: ONE card reading 3999 riding the ice beside her; A SWARM of grey salmon heads under a paper soup pot card; ONE paper bag; ONE fish bone behind his ear
prop_continuity: the heads lie under the soup pot card from 2.15; the bone leaves his ear at 9.10
environment: a fish hall, daylight from the roof, tiled counters and crates a fin away both sides
light_events: flat white noon off the tiles, a mirror flash down her flank at 3.75, a gold glint at 9.40

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: a smug oily female voice, biting each word, 4.5 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: prosh-LI, vre-me-NA, lo-SO-sya, te-PER, ma-YA, O-che-red, blis-TAT, BU-desh, KAZH-doy, KOS-toch-ke
audio.pacing: 0.00-1.90, 2.15-4.25 and 4.50-6.45 each one breath; after 6.45 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: her jaw opens wide and shapes every syllable
audio.sfx: ice crunching, trays scraping, crates banging, boots pounding, a wet guffaw, a spit

timeline.a: the tray shoves off, she rears up off the ice, head to the lens
she rides the tray past a crate raking across behind her
her tail whips and hurls the grey salmon heads off the tray at the lens
the heads slap on the tile, he drops the soup pot card on them, running
she shoves the 3999 card upright with her nose
she throws her body over, the tray skidding under her
she rises on her tail, fins wide, crates banging past
she arcs her flank at the lens, light ripping down it
the tray hits a rut, ice jumping up around her
she leans in at the lens, jaw wide, the aisle tearing past
the tray slams through a rut, ice and water sheeting across the lens
she throws her flank at the lens, crates ripping past both sides
she dives at the lens over the 3999 card, jaw wide, filling the frame, the aisle ripping past
the tray rams between his boots and hauls her on, he pounding alongside a fin away, crates sheeting across the lens
he swings the paper bag over her on the run, she whips her tail and hurls the ice across the lens into his cap
running level with her he rips the banknotes from the buyer arms across the lens into his apron
he flicks the bone off his ear across the lens, she snaps it out of the air and grins into the lens

must_appear: the 3999 card rides beside her all clip; at 1.25 her tail hurls the heads off the tray; every line is spoken, the last word by 6.45; she stays on the moving tray to the last frame, never lifted or carried; at 6.45 she fills the lens alive and furious; from 6.45 he runs and never stands; order: dive, boots, bag, banknotes, bone, one to a beat
negative_prompt: subtitles, watermark, letterbox, night, dark scene, cyrillic letters, words, a parked camera, a standing seller, a fish lifted off the tray, weighing scales, a closed jaw while speaking, slow motion, an empty aisle, a far wall, a word not in the lines
